assetProvenance.prompt: Create a sophisticated editorial illustration for a Colombian teacher professional-learning resource. Landscape 3:2 composition, full-bleed, elegant contemporary hand-painted gouache with fine pencil contour details, tactile but clean, warm believable human expressions, natural body proportions and hands. Restrained palette: deep ink blue #173b54, petrol green #21685e, pale blue-gray #eaf2f4, touches of mustard yellow #fbc900, natural varied skin tones. Visually rich authored scene with thoughtfully layered composition and soft daylight, professional educational publishing quality, not childish clipart, not 3D, not a generic vector flat-design corporate illustration. No letters, words, labels, logos, UI, borders, or watermark. Fictional people, not a representation of an actual school. Depict a Colombian female teacher and four teenage students of diverse Afro-Colombian and mestizo backgrounds around a classroom table, all visible in a welcoming sunlit classroom. The teacher listens attentively while a student shares a notebook, other students show engaged curiosity and mutual encouragement. A small potted plant, window light and understated classroom shelving in background. The meaning is belonging, emotional trust and rigorous collaborative learning. Compose the five people naturally across the middle of the frame, retain their heads and gestures inside the central 80 percent so a wide crop stays readable. Navy and teal clothing with a single small yellow accent. Avoid literal flags or cultural stereotypes.

assetProvenance.prompt: Create an extraordinary, polished contemporary editorial cover artwork for a professional educational digital resource about socioemotional skills, learning and collective leadership. Landscape 1536x1024. A seamless deep petrol navy blue studio background, approximately hex #102f43, with the LEFT 48 PERCENT completely empty clean navy negative space, no objects or details there: readable website text will be overlaid later. All of the sculptural subject belongs on the RIGHT HALF, around x=1100 y=500, with safe margins. A beautifully crafted, tactile, elegant off-white open book seen in three-quarter perspective, its pages transforming into three broad graceful interweaving sculptural ribbons that form an airy circular compass-like structure above the book. One ribbon is rich saturated golden yellow, one is muted jade teal, one is porcelain white. A small precise gold directional needle suspended at the center of the open circular structure suggests orientation and shared purpose. The ribbons must have refined folded-paper material with natural subtle texture, physically convincing light and soft shadows, not metallic, not shiny plastic, not inflated balloons. Sculptural editorial installation photographed at high-end studio quality. Confident bold silhouette, elegant unexpected composition, sophisticated education publishing art direction, no decorative confetti, no scattered floating trinkets, no spheres, no neon glow, no gradients as the main subject, no people. Quiet navy background all the way to every edge. Light is soft and directional from the upper right, giving the sculpture depth and readable pale highlights. Ground the book at the bottom-right with subtle cast shadow. No letters, symbols with words, text, UI, logos, border or watermark anywhere. This is a conceptual editorial image, not a diagram or a webpage screenshot.

Landscape 3:2 composition, full-bleed, elegant contemporary hand-painted gouache with fine pencil contour details, tactile but clean, warm believable human expressions, natural body proportions and hands. Restrained palette: deep ink blue #173b54, petrol green #21685e, pale blue-gray #eaf2f4, touches of mustard yellow #fbc900, natural varied skin tones. Visually rich authored scene with thoughtfully layered composition and soft daylight, professional educational publishing quality, not childish clipart, not 3D, not a generic vector flat-design corporate illustration. No letters, words, labels, logos, UI, borders, or watermark. Fictional people, not a representation of an actual school. Depict a close three-quarter overhead view of a shared classroom worktable with four teenage students collaboratively building a small community garden model from paper and cardboard. Diverse natural skin tones; part of the students' engaged faces and upper bodies visible near the top edges, their hands arranging miniature plants and paths at the center. Rich calm teal and ink blue tones, light cool paper background, small mustard accent supplies. No readable writing on any object. Model should stay central and visible under a 16:9 crop.

narrative.overview:
El sistema combina una portada editorial conceptual con un atlas pedagógico interior. Mantiene Figtree y la identidad azul, verde petróleo y amarillo ExC; el inicio ahora usa fondo azul profundo, texto blanco, HSE y CTA amarillos, con una composición de libro, brújula y cintas.

La jerarquía combina títulos grandes, texto de apoyo moderado y bloques delimitados por líneas finas o fondos tonales. Los esquemas interiores de relaciones y habilidades mantienen el lenguaje de atlas; las actividades conservan controles explícitos y retroalimentación textual. La portada conceptual reemplaza el mapa interactivo inicial.

La imagen conceptual de portada tiene materialidad de papel plegado e iluminación de estudio, sin personas. Las escenas ficticias de aula y colaboración conservan su lenguaje editorial gouache: el aula se reutiliza ahora como soporte de seis puntos SEL y de tres situaciones del simulador; la colaboración acompaña ExC y el cuarto caso. Los controles son HTML/CSS/SVG funcionales, no parte del raster. No hubo generación nueva de imágenes.
keyCharacteristics: Figtree como única familia tipográfica, con respaldo del sistema.
Tinta azul para lectura y selección; verde petróleo para énfasis y conexiones.
Amarillo ExC en HSE, CTA de portada, detalles y navegación actual.
Líneas cartográficas, círculos y paneles tonales con esquinas suaves.
Portada conceptual y escenas de aula y colaboración originales, reutilizadas con procedencia y disclosure.
Exploración por puntos, círculos, decisiones en dos etapas y biblioteca por propósito.
dos: **Do** conservar Figtree, la pila de respaldo y los roles cromáticos existentes.
**Do** mantener texto explicativo junto a estados de respuesta y progreso.
**Do** conservar foco visible, nombres accesibles y reducción de movimiento al extender componentes.
**Do** respetar los breakpoints y las posiciones finales de la cascada móvil.
**Do** reutilizar el logo preexistente `docs/excolombia.png`, suministrado por el usuario, como archivo de identidad de Enseña por Colombia.
**Do** conservar los textos alternativos, los pies y el disclosure de escenas ficticias junto a la procedencia de las ilustraciones.
donts: **Don't** modificar, regenerar ni re-encodear el logo suministrado.
**Don't** introducir inputs o textareas para las actividades: el sistema construido usa botones de elección.
**Don't** confundir el guardado del avance con persistencia de elecciones o envío de respuestas.
**Don't** presentar colores locales o rampas sintetizadas como tokens implementados.
**Don't** convertir esta documentación de código en claims de validación visual, accesibilidad certificada o rendimiento medido.
**Don't** presentar las ilustraciones generadas como fotografías de una comunidad educativa real.
